title: Music Therapy
description: Using music to address physical, emotional, cognitive, and social needs through listening, singing, or playing instruments.

title: Cinema Therapy
description: Using films as a therapeutic tool to gain insight, process emotions, and stimulate discussion about personal challenges.

title: Sand Therapy
description: A hands-on therapeutic approach using sand and miniature objects to create scenes that reflect one's inner world.

title: Mandala Drawing Therapy
description: A calming art therapy technique using mandalas to reduce anxiety and bring focus and emotional balance.

title: Drama Therapy
description: Using theater techniques and role-playing to explore emotional issues and foster personal growth.

title: Dance Movement Therapy
description: Using movement and dance to support intellectual, emotional, and motor functions of the body.

title: Collage Therapy
description: Creating collages from various materials to express feelings and thoughts that might be hard to verbalize.

title: Photography Therapy
description: Using photography as a means of self-expression and exploration of personal identity and perspective.

title: Clay Therapy
description: Working with clay to release emotions, reduce stress, and improve self-esteem through tactile creation.

title: Poetry Therapy
description: Using reading, writing, and discussing poetry to promote healing and personal growth.

title: Puppet Therapy
description: Using puppets to act out emotions and experiences, helping individuals express difficult feelings in a safe, symbolic way.

title: Nature Art Therapy
description: Creating art with natural materials (leaves, twigs, stones) to foster grounding, mindfulness, and connection to the environment.
